limitations: One sequential before/after process run per synthetic corpus; uncontrolled filesystem caches.
ARW-name stress fixtures are invalid image bytes plus valid synthetic XMP, solely for persistence scaling; their preview/metadata failures are expected.
All nine real files are ILCE-7CR: this does not establish additional Sony camera-model coverage.
Workspace first-preview timing includes decoder initialization and concurrent indexing, unlike previews after the thumbnail phase in the original pipeline benchmark.
Synthetic JPEG/PNG templates contain no shooting EXIF; ISO sort mainly measures missing-value/name comparisons.
No native frame timing, Lightroom interoperability, minimum-macOS or Intel verification is implied.
